description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

The US military regularly sells outdated equipment to civilians, including M1 Garand rifles, M1903 Springfield rifles, M1911 pistols, and M1 Carbines through the Civilian Marksmanship Program. Beyond firearms, retired helmets, gas masks, backpacks, tools, and even collectible badges and medals are sold as military surplus. This video explains why the US military sells rather than scraps outdated gear, and what types of decommissioned equipment civilians can legally purchase today.
